applies_why: The judge treats the challenged curse limb as dropped and therefore not a live link, so it does not perform the chain-against-chain weighing Rule K-C governs.
quote: D6 vs C4 (Jeremiah 22:30): UNDERDETERMINED -- C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.
room: pressed against a link — either the dropped curse limb is no longer a live link, so the rule is not triggered, or it remains a pressed link that must be weighed chain against chain by footing.
why: The judge dismissed C4 only because its target limb was dropped, not by applying the retired stating-verse test or weighing a live pressed link verse by verse.
